description: F-100D Super Sabre displayed on the coastal plaza at Gemikonagi near Lefke as the Cengiz Topel monument, commemorating the Turkish pilot shot down over Cyprus on 8 August 1964. The airframe is painted as 55-2766, the aircraft actually lost, and carries the buzz code FW-766; those are commemorative markings, not this airframe's identity, so the serial is left blank. Northern, Turkish Cypriot-administered Cyprus. Visible on the plaza in Esri imagery of 7 October 2024.
